name: pr-review
description: Three reviewers look at the same pull request in parallel (security, performance, readability) and a summary decides: ok or changes-requested. Read-only; runs unattended in CI.

stages.name: Security
stages.promptTemplate:
Review the pull request below for security problems: injection, unsafe deserialization, secrets in code, missing authorization, unsafe file or network access. Quote the file and line for every finding; say so if you find nothing.

Task: {task}

stages.name: Performance
stages.promptTemplate:
Review the pull request below for performance problems: needless allocations, N+1 queries, blocking calls in async code, unbounded loops or collections. Quote the file and line for every finding; say so if you find nothing.

Task: {task}

stages.name: Style & readability
stages.promptTemplate:
Review the pull request below for readability and maintainability: naming, structure, dead code, missing tests for new behaviour. Quote the file and line for every finding; say so if you find nothing.

Task: {task}

stages.name: Summary
stages.promptTemplate:
Write the review comment for this pull request from the three reviews above: a short verdict, then a checklist of what must change before merging (blocking) and what is only a suggestion. Keep it under 300 words.

Task: {task}
